note: Illinois DNR park north of Loves Park, at Pierce Lake. Four wooded electric loops (Plum Grove, Prairie View, Staghorn, White Oak) sit 400 m+ north of the lake; the lakeside Hickory Hills loop is tent-only. Sites take 25-40 ft. From November to April the sites keep electric but water and the dump station shut off. Alcohol-free park. --Claude
